test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Eight friends A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting anti-clockwise around a circular table in the same sequence facing the centre with an equal distance between them. G is sitting in the east. C and E interchange their places. Who is sitting in the southeast direction?
solution:
Eight friends **A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H** are sitting anti-clockwise around a circular table in the same sequence facing the centre with an equal distance between them. 

G is sitting in the east. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce89615537f7a14a2dc302ab9510fda7f2391b290582c0f11a1115d959bece60.png] 

C and E interchange their places. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09585ddfd63c8b7abb3fe99821a4d695f4889f761282438f82e2463940a4d54d.png] 

Clearly, F is sitting in the southeast direction.

Hence, '**F**' is the correct answer.
